reasons: Section 2.2's 'sole and exclusive provider ... throughout the term' is exclusivity binding Customer with no category limit, no time limit and no performance exit — the playbook walk-away position, so a deviation finding is correctly classified as high severity.

The redline deletes p0013 in full, which reaches the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer) and is the minimal edit consistent with the redline guidance ('delete or narrow'); no other Customer-binding exclusivity text is left, and the Customer-favourable Section 12.3 language is untouched.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and that no residual requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains.

The comment is accurate (correctly notes the direct conflict with Section 12.3), cites the playbook position, offers the 12-month, category-limited, SLA-terminable fallback, and matches the required prefix and concise first-person-plural tone.
